item: A shipped stoplist change reaches the stored top keywords and the cached Home cards (R111 step T3)
summary: A fingerprint of the shipped stoplist decides when the stored Article.top_keyword_id/count/tied_n are recomputed (only for articles whose top set held a hidden word, a non-lowest tie member included; three columns only, updated_at untouched, no mention row moves) by one resumable job in the off-peak window and its offline timer, each chunk one short transaction sized to hold the write window about a quarter of a second, stopping at a chunk boundary for the storage or memory guard, the fingerprint recorded only after the last chunk. The Home cache carries the fingerprint it was made under and refreshes through the existing background path when it differs. Measured on a 200,000-article synthetic store: plaintext 6.4 s with a longest window of 0.27 s, the same store encrypted (SQLCipher) 7.3 s with 0.29 s, and an independent recompute matched on every article; the in-pass memory is capped at 500,000 ids (about 31 MiB measured) and a smaller cap only slows the pass.
